name: Los Lunas
seo_title: Los Lunas Christmas Events for Kids 2026: 3 Events, 1 Free
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Los Lunas, New Mexico for 2026: 3 family events, 1 free, with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Los Lunas builds its Christmas around Village parks events at Heritage Park and a campus luminaria night, and in past years Santa's visit was held at the Rail Runner's Los Lunas Transportation Center.
celebrates: The Village of Los Lunas Parks and Recreation Division runs the town's holiday calendar, with a Christmas Light Parade on December 5 and a Santa's Coming into Town evening at Heritage Park on December 11 that adds a Christmas Light Up Drone Show at 8 pm. UNM-Valencia adds its own tradition, the Luminaria Stroll with a balloon glow, children's crafts and photos with Santa at the campus library. The Village's Christmas Celebrations page gathers these December events under one roof.
lastyear: The Rio Metro Regional Transit District and the Village of Los Lunas presented Santa's Coming to Town on Friday, December 13, 2024, at the Los Lunas Transportation Center from 3 to 7 pm. It was free and featured games, crafts, a tree lighting and pictures with Santa. In 2023 the event ran from 5 to 9 pm on December 9, with a stocking giveaway, a model train exhibit and face painting. These are the most recent records on the Rio Metro calendar.
facts: The 2023 Santa's Coming to Town included a Christmas stocking giveaway, interactive model trains, ornament crafts, balloon twisting and a selfie with Trax, the Rail Runner mascot. Father Christmas arrived at 6 pm. The 2026 Village event moves to Heritage Park, and the Village's vendor listing says the December 11 Christmas event is held there. UNM-Valencia calls its stroll the fifth annual.
trains: The New Mexico Rail Runner Express stops at the Los Lunas Transportation Center, 101 Courthouse Road, and Rio Metro says the Rail Runner moved to its Fall and Winter schedule on November 1, 2026. There is no Rail Runner or Rio Metro bus service on Thanksgiving Day or Christmas Day. In earlier years Rio Metro added special trains for Santa's Coming to Town, and kids 9 and under always ride free. South in Belen, the Harvey House Museum sits beside the rail line.
train_links: A restored Fred Harvey dining house beside the rail line, with freight trains close by and holiday lights in season.
traditions: A Village parade of vehicles decorated with lights, held in the evening at Heritage Park.
The Village's Christmas event with Santa, lights and music at Heritage Park, followed by a drone show.
Los Lunas Parks and Recreation launches a Christmas Light Up Drone Show at 8 pm.
UNM-Valencia lines its campus with luminarias and adds a balloon glow.
Rio Metro has paired Santa with the Rail Runner and a model train exhibit at the Transportation Center.
kidfact: Rail Runner kids 9 and under always ride free, so a Santa trip by train costs a child nothing.
faq: How does Los Lunas celebrate Christmas?

The Village of Los Lunas holds a Christmas Light Parade and a Santa's Coming into Town evening at Heritage Park, and UNM-Valencia hosts a luminaria stroll with a balloon glow. The Village gathers its December events on its Christmas Celebrations page, and families can check each listing for hours and prices.
Where is Santa's Coming into Town held?

In 2026 the Village's Christmas Celebrations page lists Heritage Park, from 5 to 9 pm on December 11. In 2024 and 2023 the event was held at the Los Lunas Transportation Center beside the Rail Runner station, so always check the current listing.
Can we take the train to a Los Lunas event?

The Rail Runner stops at the Los Lunas Transportation Center. Rio Metro has added special trains for the Santa event in past years, and children 9 and under ride free. There is no service on Christmas Day.
Are there luminarias in Los Lunas?
UNM-Valencia holds its Luminaria Stroll on its campus at 280 La Entrada Road, with luminarias, a balloon glow, Santa photos and crafts, all in the evening on December 2.
